findings.title: Control plane still executes a mutable working tree (dirty-guarded, not pinned)
evidence: deploy/edge-control-plane.service:24 ExecStartPre refuses start when git status --porcelain is non-empty
deploy/edge-control-plane.service:25 ExecStart runs src/ from that tree
findings.impact: A dirty tree is refused, but the service still runs whatever commit is checked out rather than a pinned, verified release artifact; an uncommitted-but-clean wrong branch can still run.
findings.recommendation: Deploy a pinned bundle (release artifact with SHA-256) and run from it; keep the dirty check as defense in depth.
findings.note: re-audit 2026-10-04: still-open; dirty guard added as mitigation

findings.title: Edge control plane is a co-tenant single point of failure on the shared lab host
evidence: deploy/edge-control-plane.service:16-18 runs as user `user` on the shared falcon host
README.md: environment class LAB, single Ubuntu 24.04 KVM host
No warm standby / no separate host in deploy/
findings.impact: Loss or compromise of the shared host takes down the edge control plane and any co-tenant monitoring services together; no standby exists.
findings.recommendation: Isolate the control plane on its own host/VM or add a warm standby with a documented failover; record as a production-readiness precondition.

findings.title: Bare stdlib HTTP transport now has connection cap, timeout and rate limiting
findings.impact: The earlier unbounded-thread transport risk is closed.

report:
- Read-only analysis of `MaineCyberTech/falcon-edge` at `ba4becb` (git `ba4becb6ecd8fdc0c4e0363a67d7a62f60985788`, branch `main`).
- Deterministic lens (LLM-free) run on the lab (`ci-runner`, HTTP job API) and locally: LICENSE absent; no non-executable tracked `*.sh`; no CRLF tracked text; no tracked secret-like filenames; `.gitattributes` present.
- Wave-0 inventory via `tools/repo_inventory.py` (1,410 files; 5 workflows; 3 routes; 17 schema tables; 56 test files).
- Target repository is not applicable to this domain; the finding records the evidence and the future-readiness trigger.
- No secrets printed; all evidence is file:line references.
